text: SELECT products.product_id, products.product_name, SUM(order_items.product_price) AS revenue FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items" AS order_items JOIN "jaffle_shop"."dev"."products" AS products ON order_items.product_id = products.product_id GROUP BY products.product_id, products.product_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, products.product_name LIMIT 10
